# Claims triage assistant

Larkspur Digital's engagement with Fenwick Mutual (a UK home and motor insurer)
to help claims handlers triage first notifications of loss (FNOL). The
assistant reads a new claim's notification, checks the policy's cover through
the policy system's read-only API, and drafts a triage recommendation (claim
type, urgency, cover position with the clause it relies on) that a handler
accepts or changes.

The pilot went live for 14 triage handlers on 2026-08-25.

- Discovery brief: `docs/discovery/claims.md`
- Design: `docs/architecture/claims.md`
- Plan, measurement and incident records: `docs/plans/claims.md`

# Claims triage assistant: September 2026

One page for Helen Okafor. Report written late (28 October 2026); the call date above is an assumption, see the plan's change table.

**Bottom line:** Median triage time fell to 13 minutes against a 21-minute baseline (M2, M1), but the re-routing counter-metric has no September measurement (M3 covers only 25-31 August), so we recommend continue, not scale.

## Outcome against baseline

- Median triage time per claim: 13 minutes on pilot claims against a baseline of 21 minutes (M2, M1; pilot window 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, 1,184 claims; baseline window 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-22, 400 new home claims; both from the claims MI report, same definition and scope).
- An 8-minute (38%) fall is far beyond the margin on these samples (about 1 over the square root of 1,184, roughly 3%). Target: 12 minutes or less (brief §4), so the target is not yet met by one minute.

## Counter-metric

- Re-routing rate after triage: not measured for September. The only record is 8.6% against a 9% baseline (M3; window 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-31, 236 claims, build v1.0.1), which is last period, a different build, and a 0.4-point gap within the margin of that sample. G09 (added to the plan) measures September.

## Adoption

- Active means a handler who opened a draft on 5 or more claims in a week, in every week of September.
- 12 of 14 pilot handlers were active (M5), 86%; 69% of 1,184 drafts were accepted without change (M4).

## Cost per outcome

- Actual: £0.43 per claim triaged: £512 (M6: Cloud Billing export, rows labelled app=claims-triage; Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery; leaves out Larkspur build and support time) over 1,184 claims triaged with a draft (M7); we estimate £512 / 1,184 = £0.43. This is within the £900 a month pilot ceiling (brief §6).
- Estimate: £0.31 per claim at 4,800 claims a month (M8). We could not reproduce it: £512 spread over 4,800 claims with fixed costs unchanged is about £0.11, and £0.31 a claim at 4,800 would be about £1,490 a month. The plan's figure needs its derivation before it is used; the 4,800 volume is not in the brief (about 1,200 a month in the pilot queue).
- Per accepted-unchanged draft (stricter unit): £512 / 817 is not stated as a record; not reported (817 is 69% of 1,184, arithmetic on M4 and M7).

## Incidents

- I1: 2026-09-16, severity 2, 37 drafts cited a clause from a superseded wording version; drafts withheld for two hours and handlers triaged by hand; wording index rebuilt with a version filter and a C2 test added; closed 2026-09-19.

## Thresholds

| Threshold sentence (brief §4) | This period | Fired |
| --- | --- | --- |
| If the median triage time on pilot claims is above 15 minutes after four pilot weeks, we will stop the pilot and review the drafts with the team leads | 13 minutes (M2) | no |
| If the re-routing rate rises above 9% in any month, we will pause the assistant's urgency field until the cause is found | not measured for September (M3 is August, 8.6%) | unknown |

## Call: continue

Helen Okafor decides by 2026-11-04 (assumed date). We recommend continue: the stop threshold did not fire and cost is inside the ceiling, but scale needs the September re-routing rate. Options: stop (frees about £512 a month plus the retained Cloud SQL instance), continue (October must show the re-routing rate at or under 9%, triage time at 12 minutes or less, and the M8 derivation), scale (to home volume beyond the pilot queue; cost per claim at that scope cannot be stated until M8 is fixed).
EOF
